entries.116793b58f06152a: Under the management slogan “One Step Ahead of the Game ～ Sono Ichite-saki e,” and based on the “Asgent Medium- to Long-Term Growth Strategy,” it is expanding its service menu toward introducing the latest security products and providing smart security services. In products, it aims to win large-scale projects for government agencies and enterprises with its existing core products, accelerate sales of new products and build recurring revenue. In services, it intends to promote development of SOC offerings and development toward providing AI-SOC services. In addition, starting from the solution “Hirundo,” which addresses risks inherent in generative AI, it intends to promote service deployment in the security area for AI environments (Security for AI).
